leadText: The Knight in the Ruins (Japanese: 遺跡で出逢った騎士 The Knight Encountered in the Ruins) is the 102nd episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and the 1,334th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on July 4, 2025, in the United Kingdom on February 27, 2026, in sub-Saharan Africa on March 15, 2026, and in the United States on March 20, 2026.
plainText:
The Knight in the Ruins (Japanese: 遺跡で出逢った騎士 The Knight Encountered in the Ruins) is the 102nd episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and the 1,334th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on July 4, 2025, in the United Kingdom on February 27, 2026, in sub-Saharan Africa on March 15, 2026, and in the United States on March 20, 2026.
 

==Blurb==
 
 At Naranja Academy, Penny challenges Dot to battle! Quaxwell and Tinkatuff give their all against Penny’s Flareon and Sylveon, and Dot is surprised by the results. Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult go searching for traces of Laquium, but a wild Gimmighoul sets them on an unexpected quest to gather coins. Liko then meets a Trainer whose Scovillain went out of control after a Strong Sphere was used on it, and she and Meowscarada must calm it down with a battle. Suddenly, they receive some unexpected help from a familiar face! 

==Plot==
 
After Penny challenges Dot to a Double Battle of their own, the two s stand on opposite ends of the battlefield as Dendra, as the referee, explains they'll be using the same rules as the before. With Dot having the advantage considering the type match-ups, Dendra starts the battle. Penny makes the first move by having her to use that is blocked by Dot's Tinkatuff's . Dot's Quaxwell lands a on Penny's Sylveon, causing Penny to order her Pokémon to attack Tinkatuff simultaneously. While she was able to hold off the attacks, Dot attempts to have Quaxwell help Tinkatuff, but for some reason, he doesn't act, leading to Tinkatuff being dealt damage. Dot realizes Quaxwell is infatuated with Penny's Sylveon thanks to the latter's Ability, , when he attacked with Liquidation earlier. As such, Dot tries to have Quaxwell go to attack , only for Sylveon to step in and make him retreat without doing anything. Frustrated, Tinkatuff knocks some sense into Quaxwell with her hammer as Dot asks, successfully removing the status condition, to the surprise of Penny and since it's usually removed when Sylveon is knocked out. With Quaxwell back to normal, both Trainers pull out their Tera Orbs and stallize their respective Pokémon. Sylveon attacks with Moonblast, and Quaxwell takes the attack after launching Tinkatuff into the air. Tinkatuff uses onto the ground, dealing damage to both opponents and shocking Penny, and Quaxwell follows up with another Liquidation on Sylveon. Unfortunately, Flareon uses the opportunity to leap in on an unsuspecting Quaxwell and defeat him with , winning Penny the battle. Everyone is impressed by the battle and in awe at Penny's talent and strength, which Nemona credits to her spending so much time around the top trainers of the Pokemon League. Fired up by the battle, Ult wants to battle next. However, school hours have ended with the bell chiming, forcing Ult to wait until next time.

In the meeting room of the Brave Olivine, the team goes over the data that Penny gathered, and Roy notices the newest Laquium Sign sighting was at the same ruins that they explored with Raifort the year before. Since it's nearby, Dot suggests they check it out, and everyone agrees, with Murdock preparing a picnic set for the younger members before they leave. Upon arriving at the area, the four members split up to cover more ground. While investigating, Liko comes across , a student of Naranja Academy who is looking for his Pokémon partner , who disappeared the day before. While she hasn't seen the Pokémon, Liko promises to keep an eye for it just as Roy informs her everyone else has gathered for lunch at the watchtower.

The group settles down for a picnic, with Liko realizing this is Dot's first one with them. They bring up how Liko made a picnic set for Dot who preferred to stay in her room back then, with the latter admitting she had fun making sandwiches with Ludlow that time. The group have a fulfilling picnic before setting off for a second round of investigation. Dot muses how they'll need plenty of money to travel around if they want to spread the truth of the Laquium, especially since their funds primarily came from the odd jobs that Friede and Captain Pikachu did. Ult's comes over with a worthless coin, causing Liko and Dot to recall how Roy collected plenty of coins when he was controlled by , which Ult finds humorous. Roy says he won't fall for it this time, which Ult is skeptical of. All the while, the group doesn't realize they are being watched by the .
 
The Rising Volt Tacklers resume their search. However, instead of clues, Roy ironically finds a Gimmighoul Coin, with everyone else joining in, except for Liko and her Pokémon, as a result of Gimmighoul's control. Liko notices her friends' absence while Pagogo wanders off, finding a certain area very familiar. It enters an opening and finds the it had met last year. The two Pokémon interact with each other before Charcadet realizes three of its friends are missing. Liko calls out for Pagogo when she realizes it disappeared as well, only for to get her attention on footprints that emit pink smoke. She investigates further when she couldn't contact her friends, who were still looking for Gimmighoul Coins. They find a trio of wild Pokémon, who happens to be Charcadet's missing friends, fleeing from a rampaging Scovillain. Liko has Meowscarada distract Scovillain while her heals the wild Pokémon with , realizing in the process the Scovillain is Pepper's missing partner. Meowscarada is gradually getting overpowered by Scovillain's attacks, while Liko is unsure on her next step. The wild runs off scared, and Liko dives in to protect her from Scovillain's attack, only for it to never come. Liko looks up and sees Charcadet riding on Pagogo, remembering the Charcadet as the one from the year before as well. Facing Scovillain head on, Charcadet takes on the attack, not taking any damage thanks to its Ability. Charcadet also gains a boost in its , allowing it to knock down Scovillain long enough for Pagogo to purify the Laquium from the Spicy Pepper Pokémon.
 
Liko brings Scovillain to Pepper, who is happy to reunite with his partner, before asking if he used a Strong Sphere. While surprised, Pepper confirms he uses a Strong Sphere, but it's not on him as he sent it back to Exceed to get it recharged after it ran out of energy from many uses. Pepper thanks Liko for bringing back Scovillain, and she returns to see Charcadet waiting for her with its friends. She sadly informs the Fire Child Pokémon of her need to leave and thanks it for helping them earlier. However, encouraged by Pagogo and its friends, Charcadet ends up stepping up and kneeling to Liko, offering its protection. Liko accepts Charcadet's offer and takes out a , allowing to join her team.

Afterwards, Liko rejoins her friends and is exasperated to see them under Gimmighoul's control, snapping out of it a moment later. Back in the Brave Olivine, the younger members speculate how using the Strong Sphere could sever a bond between a Trainer and Pokémon, using the battle against the Explorers' as a possible reference. Dot then receives a video message from , who asks to have a handshake event as their next collaboration. Dot reluctantly agrees to hold it as a means to earn some money, making Liko overjoyed. Meanwhile, the Gimmighoul from earlier has secretly stowed away on the airship.
 

==Major events==
 
 
Dot and Penny have a Double Battle, with Penny winning after scoring the first knockout.
Liko reunites with the she previously met, and it is revealed to know and have as its Ability.
Liko .
The from a year prior secretly stows away on the Brave Olivine.

==Trivia==
Mega Nidothing's Mega Mega! Mega Evolution: 
The first eyecatch features Dot with her and , and the second features Penny with her and .
Zirc, his , and Onia narrate the preview of the next episode.
This episode marks the first time that a female main character has caught a that isn't a first partner Pokémon, not counting temporary .
This is also the first time that a female main character has officially caught a Fire-type since obtained her in A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!, 531 episodes earlier.
This episode marks the first appearance of a in the animated series since League Offenders and Defenders!, 267 episodes earlier.
